propositions: Extraction from free-text JSON is heuristic and vulnerable to trailing schema-valid decoys winning when models fence-wrap quoted content, requiring an explicit output channel with sentinel markers to guarantee payload location.

The parser must extract only complete marker blocks (<<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>> paired with <<<END>>>) in line-anchored, non-nested fashion, iterate them in reverse document order, and return the first block that validates, raising the last block's error if none validate.

Markerless replies or incomplete markers (unterminated opening) must fall through to the existing schema-filtered selection pipeline byte-for-byte unchanged, preserving backward compatibility with df3a-era and non-compliant-model transcripts.

The bounded-retry prompt at structured_run.py must name the same markers as the first attempt so the fail-closed retry channel remains consistent and does not instruct bare JSON that contradicts the sentinel directive.

Markers are recognized only when alone on their own line, making them collision-proof against JSON string values containing the literal marker text (a payload cannot place <<<END>>> unescaped on its own line per JSON grammar).

Empty marker blocks, repeated/interleaved markers, and blocks needing JSON repair must all be handled deterministically: empty blocks fail-closed via tolerant_parse, multiple blocks apply last-wins, repair is inherited per-block from the existing tolerant_parse path.
